name: Conversion
overview: Conversion is a transformative work of God’s grace, involving a cleansing from sin and the gift of a new heart and spirit, as Ezekiel 36 reveals God’s promise to remove a stony heart and replace it with one that obeys His statutes. It follows repentance, as seen in Acts 2 where those convicted ask what to do, and Peter instructs them to repent and be baptized for the remission of sins, promising the gift of the Holy Spirit. Faith and baptism are essential components, with Mark 16 emphasizing that belief and baptism lead to salvation, while unbelief results in condemnation.
